items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So, but Ray gave me the idea to play something, some kind of solo.

ctx.x: I never played -- I never was a soloist. I thought it was stupid. I always thought drum solos were very stupid, you know? So I never -- I always concentrated on

accompaniment. I thought that was the most important thing. That was my most basic function as a drummer, was to accompany, and so I always stuck with that. And I think that's why a lot of the musicians liked me so much, because I never show off and always think about them first. So, but Ray gave me the idea to play something, some kind of solo.
